title: Equivalence tolerance table
description: Cross-stack equivalence tolerance table (spec § 2.6). Per-category defaults + optional per-sim overrides. Phase-3 additive extension: render-similarity thresholds per (category, sim) under top-level `render_similarity` (D-SCHEMA Stage-1a lean; schema only, no Phase-3 rows — tasks 6 and 8 add rows).

render_similarity.description: Phase-3 additive extension (D-SCHEMA). Render-similarity thresholds per (category, sim). PSNR/SSIM are floor-thresholds (`*_min`; larger = more similar); LPIPS is a ceiling-threshold (`lpips_max`; smaller = more similar). Phase-3 §2.12 quality floors: PSNR ≥ 28 dB, SSIM ≥ 0.85, LPIPS ≤ 0.15. Tasks 6 and 8 add rows; this sub-phase (render-similarity) ships the schema only.

additionalProperties.description: Per-category render-similarity table (key = sim category, e.g. `continuous-ca` or `neural-rendered`).

psnr_min.description: PSNR floor (dB); sim PASSES if measured PSNR >= psnr_min. Phase-3 §2.12 floor = 28 dB.

ssim_min.description: SSIM floor; sim PASSES if measured SSIM >= ssim_min. Phase-3 §2.12 floor = 0.85.

lpips_max.description: LPIPS ceiling; sim PASSES if measured LPIPS <= lpips_max. Phase-3 §2.12 ceiling = 0.15.

golden_tolerance.description: Phase-3 additive extension (lenia-tolerance-schema-fix). Golden-table tolerances per (category, sim) for SINGLE-stack sims that carry no cross-stack equivalence pair (i.e. cannot use `overrides.<sim>` which is cross-stack relative/absolute resolution wiring). Phase-3 plan §3.2.4 enumerates the per-sim key shapes (e.g. lenia: `golden_kernel_abs/rel`, `golden_trajectory_abs`; pinn-poisson: `analytical_l2`, `fd_l2`; articulated-pedagogical: `pendulum_period_rel`, `trajectory_abs`, `energy_drift_rel_per_second`). Per-sim keys are bespoke to each anchor family, so per-sim entries permit additional numeric/boolean/string properties; the schema enforces the (category, sim) two-level nesting only. Mirrors the `render_similarity` additive-extension shape established at sub-phase-phase-3-render-similarity Stage 1a.

additionalProperties.description: Per-category golden-tolerance table (key = sim category, e.g. `continuous-ca`, `rigid-body`, `soft-body`, `learned-dynamics`).

Per-sim golden-tolerance entry (key = sim short-name). Bespoke per-anchor-family keys per phase-3-plan.md §3.2.4; values are numeric scalars (abs/rel tolerances), booleans (e.g. `golden_checkpoint_match`), or strings (e.g. `training_loss_distributional_bound = "EFECT"`).
